previous_statement: Fix the universal witnesses supplied by lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, lem-extcb-four-corner-merge, and lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control. Put M:=C_merge*(C_cross^0+1), choose e_3:=min{1,a_merge/(2*(C_cross^0+1)),e_iso_unit/(2*(abs(M)+1))}, and put D_3:=1+abs(M)+abs(C_iso_unit)*(abs(M)+1). Then e_3>0 and D_3<infinity are universal, (C_cross^0+1)*e_3<=a_merge, (M+1)*e_3<=e_iso_unit, M<=D_3, and C_iso_unit*(M+1)<=D_3.
new_statement: Fix the universal witnesses supplied by lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, lem-extcb-four-corner-merge, and lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control. Put M:=C_merge*(C_cross^0+1) and K:=abs(C_merge)*(C_cross^0+1), choose e_3:=min{1,a_merge/(2*(C_cross^0+1)),e_iso_unit/(2*(K+1))}, and put D_3:=1+K+abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1). Since C_cross^0>=1, a_merge>0, and e_iso_unit>0, e_3>0 and D_3<infinity are universal. Directly from the minimum, (C_cross^0+1)*e_3<=a_merge and (M+1)*e_3<=(K+1)*e_3<=e_iso_unit; also K<=D_3 and C_iso_unit*(K+1)<=abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)<=D_3.
